title: AI Writing Has a SHAPE! #ai #chatgpt #claude
description: AI writing has a shape! 🔵 🔺 🔶 The structure of stories written by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and all other LLMs is distinct and detectable almost all of the time, whether or not there are the usual signs of AI writing like em dashes etc. This is what a recent piece of AI research found when they mapped the overall structure of AI-written stories and compared them with human-written stories. #ai #artificialintelligence #chatgpt #claude #technology #tech #learnontiktok
